title: Splitting and Joining Strings
learning_outcomes: Explain what splitting and joining strings contributes to a PHP application.
Apply at least one of these concepts in a small example: explode().
Check one edge case and explain how to diagnose unexpected behavior.

content.intro: Strings are sequences of bytes with encoding rules, not automatically user-perceived characters. Searching, transforming, matching, and displaying text require attention to Unicode and the output context. In this lesson, focus on explode(); then compare it with implode(). Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.
content.why_it_matters: You will use splitting and joining strings when building readable, testable PHP programs. Its practical value is knowing which rule applies, what result to expect, and how to handle failure or unexpected input.
